summary: Ground-site lookout on Hominy Peak, Targhee NF, Teton County: listed gone or removed; no build, staffing or site detail found in sources.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; second lookout history page says removed. No removal date is given.

evidence.supports: Location about 12 miles southwest of the South Entrance to Yellowstone
evidence.quote: 12 miles southwest of South Entrance to Yellowstone NP

evidence.supports: Agency is Targhee National Forest on second lookout page
Directory lists Hominy Peak in Teton County as a Ground site, status Gone
Second lookout history page lists the site as removed
Summit is listed inside the Jedediah Smith Wilderness
Visitors are asked to check local regulations
Komoot lists summit elevation as 2,540 m
Trail guide gives Hominy Peak summit height as 8,344 feet
evidence.quote: views of Hominy Peak (8,344') to the southwest

evidence.supports: Trail guide places the Jedediah Smith Wilderness in the Targhee National Forest, with Hominy Peak visible to the southwest from the trail
evidence.quote: the Jedediah Smith Wilderness in the Targhee National Forest to the west

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Komoot lists the summit at 2,540 m (about 8,333 ft); the Hiking Project trail description gives 8,344 ft; firelookout.com gives 8,366 ft. The differences are small, and the story gives the trail and Komoot figures.
The directory says Gone and the second lookout page says Removed; both mean no structure is listed as standing.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources give only location, agency, kind (ground site), status and a summit height; no source gives a build date, staffing, a removal date or what remains at the summit. The story is short because the evidence is short. Elevation figures differ slightly between Komoot and the trail description. The Targhee attribution is confirmed by both lookout pages; the wilderness claim rests on the Komoot listing alone.
